name: JD Onsen. Eroero Dynamite Joshi Daisei to no Onsen Seikatsu.
original_name: JD温泉。 エロエロダイナマイト女子大生との温泉生活。
source: Suddenly, during one summer, university student Yunoyama Ren was entrusted with his relative's hot spring inn. Although his uncle's illness was the cause, he felt completely unprepared as a novice. At such a time, the guests who arrived were plump female university students! In such a situation, there's no way naughty happenings wouldn't occur, leading to an explosive erotic development. In the end, even doing things like masturbating while being watched by an older woman... Such incidents became traumatic memories of the trip. The return of those girls was supposed to put an end to everything... or so it was supposed to be. 'Alright, we'll help you. We're familiar with the hot spring club, after all.' With that single remark, the continuation is decided! And so, a thrilling summer arrives under one roof!
translation:
某年夏天，大学生汤之山莲突然受托照看亲戚的温泉旅馆。叔叔生病是原因之一，但作为新手，他完全没有做好准备。偏偏此时来的客人，竟是一群身材丰满的女大学生！在这种情况下，怎么可能不发生色色的意外，情节迅速朝着爆炸性的方向发展。甚至还有被年长女性注视着自慰之类的事件，成为旅途中挥之不去的创伤记忆。

原本以为这些女孩回来后，一切就会结束……“好吧，我们来帮你。毕竟我们熟悉温泉社团。”一句话，决定了故事的后续！于是，令人心跳加速的夏日同居生活开始了！
